data.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (CI gap surfaced during waxen-sigma session)

#### Expected Behavior
The required check 'review-sub-pr' (ci.yml llm-review-sub-pr job) must actually RUN and PASS before a work->staged-* PR can merge. If its 'needs:' dependency (test-scripts / Script Tests) fails, review-sub-pr cannot run and the PR must stay BLOCKED.

#### Actual Behavior
PR #542 (worktree-20260601-183103 -> staged-fb60ad1b70e9-1780414095) auto-merged while review-sub-pr was SKIPPED. review-sub-pr 'needs: [changes, actionlint, shellcheck, lint-python, test-hooks, test-scripts]'; Script Tests FAILED (a broken doc-writer test), so review-sub-pr was skipped. GitHub treats a skipped required check as satisfied, so the auto-merge (queued by merge-to-main) fired — landing UNREVIEWED code carrying a failing Script Tests into staged-fb60. The broken test then blocked the downstream staged->main promotion (#548) and required a separate sub-PR (#547) to repair. Net: a required review was bypassed via skip-on-failed-dependency, and broken code entered the staged branch. Fix options: make review-sub-pr not 'needs:' the test jobs (so it runs independently and can post a real verdict / fail), or add a gate that treats 'skipped review-sub-pr' as non-passing for staged-* merges, or block auto-merge when any 'needs' dependency of a required check failed.
data.title: CI two-channel: review-sub-pr SKIPPED (needs: failed Script Tests) -> auto-merge into staged-* with no review + broken tests
